label: One total giver of participated esse permits a tied degree and does not entail degree adequacy
paraphrase: Closed two-bearer interpretation with actual distinct giver true and recipient false, one own-being source, source represented identity and recipient represented distinction. Giving is efficient and total at esse. A constant natural-valued scale satisfies weak adequacy with a tie. Assigning the same recipient 2 and giver 1 instead makes adequacy fail on the same causal facts. This tests dependence on the degree premise. The assignments do not claim an actual metaphysical tie or reversal.
